name: Promotional 7Ft & 9Ft Market Wooden Umbrella
material: chinese hardwood frame w/t polyester fabric, 6 ribs
description: Set up this 7 foot market umbrella at your next event or party for one of a kind brand exposure! Constructed with a 7' arc and 6 panel configuration, this umbrella features a 2-piece solid wood frame, heavy-duty 11mm fiberglass ribs, plastic ferrule and runner, plus a polyester cover with wind vents so users will be protected from the sun. With customization included, you can create a billboard for you brand at restaurants, hotels or any other venue or event with outdoor seating!
